<span id="what-it-is"></span>
== What it is ==

A Python SDK and CLI for agents that run on your hardware: a single agent or a fleet that delegates. Agents get tools, persistent knowledge-graph memory, safety filtering and effort-based model routing.

<span id="executables-installed"></span>
== Executables installed ==

<code>adk</code>, <code>adk-awdelegate</code>, <code>adk-bug</code>, <code>adk-py</code>, <code>adk-serve</code>, <code>adk-shell</code>, <code>adk-workspace</code>, <code>aither-adk</code>, <code>aither-hearth</code>, <code>awdk</code>. Command details: [[Company Brain/adk and awbrain command reference#adk|CLI reference]].

<span id="quick-start"></span>
== Quick start ==

<syntaxhighlight lang="bash">adk quickstart                        # detects hardware, pulls models, configures backends
adk init my-agent && cd my-agent && python agent.py</syntaxhighlight>
<span id="where-it-meets-the-other-bricks"></span>
== Where it meets the other bricks ==

* '''Discord:''' an <code>adk serve</code> agent is a valid back end for [[Company Brain/awdiscord|awdiscord]]. <code>adk home serve</code> can also answer on Telegram, Discord, Slack, email, WhatsApp and SMS; see [[Company Brain/Channels|Channels]].
* '''Memory:''' [[Company Brain/awbrain|awbrain]] supplies the knowledge the agent answers from.
* '''Safety:''' [[Company Brain/Approvals|Approvals]] gate anything that spends, deletes or publishes.
